verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a natural-language command interface built into Obsidian itself; the Command Palette is keyword/text-search based, not NL, and community mentions only a third-party Copilot plugin for local AI (obsidian-comm-12) rather than a native natural-language command mode. Missing for 10: first-party NL command parsing, evidence of natural-language driven actions, and any documentation of an AI-native command interface.
